rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for plants or flowers that shrivel, droop, or dry up.

example.english: The potted plant has already begun to wither after not being watered for several days.
example.traditional: 盆栽幾日冇淋水，已經枯萎喇。
example.jyutping: pun4 zoi1 gei2 jat6 mou5 lam4 seoi2 ji5 ging1 fu1 wai2 laa3

rows.note: Use this figuratively when a person, force, or institution gradually loses strength or influence.

example.english: This brand's influence is slowly starting to wither.
example.traditional: 呢個品牌嘅影響力慢慢衰退喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ban2 paai4 ge3 jing2 hoeng2 lik6 maan6 maan6 seoi1 teoi3 laa3

rows.note: Use this causative pattern when someone or something makes a plant or body part shrivel.

example.english: The scorching sun made the flowers wither.
example.jyutping: lit6 jat6 ling6 di1 faa1 fu1 wai2 saai3
